title: The Bouncer — EN/IT/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Italian German language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The bouncer doesn't knock on the door
The bouncer comes through the window at head height
And waits to see what you do about that

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Un buon bouncer non riguarda l'aggressione [A good bouncer is not about aggression]
È una domanda [It's a question]
Sei ancora qui? [Are you still here?]
Stai ancora pensando? [Are you still thinking?]
O sei già da qualche altra parte? [Or are you already somewhere else?]

[Chorus — English]
The bouncer says — good morning
The bouncer says — how do you do
The bouncer says — I know where you're standing
Do you know what I'm about to do

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Der Bouncer sagt — guten Morgen [The bouncer says — good morning]
Der Bouncer sagt — wie geht es dir [The bouncer says — how do you do]
Der Bouncer sagt — ich weiß wo du stehst [The bouncer says — I know where you're standing]
Weißt du, was ich gleich machen werde? [Do you know what I'm about to do?]

[Verse 3 — English]
Chas would watch the short ball with a quiet eye
Said — son, the bouncer's never about fury
It's about information

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
That's the bouncer
Questo è il bouncer [That's the bouncer]
Das ist der Bouncer [That's the bouncer]
That's my boy
